verses: Allah Taalaa ka hukum phoncha, abb uss ki jaldi na machao. Tamam paki uss kay liye hai woh bartar hai unn sab say jinhen yeh Allah kay nazdeek shareek batlatay hain
O hi farishton ko apni wahee dey ker apney hukum say apney bandon mein say jiss per chahata hai utarta hai kay tum logon ko aagah ker do kay meray siwa aur koi mabood nahi, pus tum mujh say daro
Ussi ney aasmano aur zamin ko haq kay sath peda kiya woh uss say buri hai jo mushrik kertay hain
Uss ney insan ko nutfay say peda kiya phir woh sareeh jhagraloo bann betha
Ussi ney chopaye peda kiye jin mein tumharay liye garmi kay libas hain aur bhi boht say nafa hain aur baaz tumharay khaney kay kaam aatay hain
Aur unn mein tumhari ronaq bhi hai jab chara ker lao tab bhi aur jab charaney ley jao tab bhi
Aur woh tumharay bojh unn shehron tak utha jatay hain jahan tum baghair aadhi jaan kiye phonch hi nahi saktay thay. Yaqeenan tumhara rab bara hi shafiq aur nihayat meharban hai
Ghoron ko, khacharon ko, gadhon ko uss ney peda kiya kay tum unn ki sawari lo aur woh baees zeenat bhi hain. Aur bhi woh aisi boht cheezen peda kerta hai jin ka tumhen ilm bhi nahi
Aur Allah per seedhi raah ka bata dena hai aur baaz tairhi raahen hain, aur agar woh chahata to tum sab ko raah raast per laga deta
O hi tumharay faeeday kay liye aasman say pani barsata hai jissay tum peetay bhi ho aur ussi say ugay huye darakhton ko tum apney janwaron ko charatay ho
Ussi say woh tumharay liye kheti aur zaitoon aur khajoor aur angoor aur her qasam kay phal ugata hai be-shak unn logon kay liye to uss mein bari nishani hai jo ghor-o-fikar kertay hain
Ussi ney raat din aur sooraj chand ko tumharay liye tabey ker diya hai aur sitaray bhi ussi kay hukum kay ma-tehat hain. Yaqeenan mein aqalmand logon kay liye kaee aik nishaniyan mojood hain
Aur bhi boht si cheezen tarah tarah kay rang roop ki uss ney tumharay liye zamin per phela rakhi hain. Be-shak naseehat qabool kerney walon kay liye uss mein bari bhari nishani hai

Aur darya bhi ussi ney tumharay bus mein ker diye hain kay tum uss mein say (nikla hua) taza gosht khao aur uss mein say apney pehanney kay zewraat nikal sako aur tum dekhtay ho kay kashtiyan uss mein pani cheerti hui (chalti) hain aur uss liye bhi kay tum uss ka fazal talash kero aur hosakta hai kay tum shukar guzari bhi kero
Aur uss ney zamin mein pahar gaar diye hain takay tumhen ley ker hilay na, aur nehren aur raahen bana den takay tum manzil maqsood ko phoncho
Aur bhi boht si nishaniyan muqarrar farmaeen. Aur sitaron say bhi log raah hasil kertay hain
To kiya woh jo peda kerta hai uss jaisa hai jo peda nahi sakta? Kiya tum bilkul nahi sochtay?
Aur agar tum Allah ki nematon ka shumar kerna chahao to tum ussay nahi ker saktay. Be-shak Allah bara bakhshney wala meharban hai
Aur jo kuch tum chupao aur zahir kero Allah Taalaa sab kuch janta hai
Aur jin jin ko yeh log Allah Taalaa kay siwa pukartay hain woh kissi cheez ko peda nahi saktay, balkay)yeh woh khud peda kiye huye hain
Murday hain zindah nahi, unhen to yeh bhi shaoor nahi kay kab uthaye jayen gay
Tum sab ka mabood sirf Allah Taalaa akela hai aur aakhirat per eman na rakhney walon kay dil munkir hain aur woh khud takabbur say bharay huye hain
Be-shak o shuba)yeh Allah Taalaa her uss cheez ko, jissay woh log chupatay hain aur jissay zahir kertay hain, bakhoobi janta hai. Woh ghuroor kerney walon ko pasand nahi farmata
Unn say jab daryaft kiya jata hai kay tumharay perwerdigar ney kiya nazil farmaya hai? To jawab detay hain kay aglon ki kahaniyan hain

Ussi ka nateeja hoga kay qayamat kay din yeh log apney pooray bojh kay sath hi unn kay bojh kay bhi hissay daar hun gay jinhen bey ilmi say gumrah kertay rahey. Dekho to kaisa bura bojh utha rahey hain

Unn say pehlay kay logon ney bhi makar kiya tha, (aakhir) Allah ney (unn kay mansoobon) ki emarton ko jaron say ukher diya aur unn (kay saron) per (unn ki) chaten upper say gir paren, aur unn kay pass azab o haan say aagaya jahan ka unhen wahm o guman bhi na tha

Phir qayamat walay din bhi Allah Taalaa unhen ruswa keray ga aur farmaye ga kay meray woh shareek kahan hain jin kay baray mein tum lartay jhagartay thay, jinhen ilm diya gaya tha woh pukar uthen gay kay aaj to kafiron ko ruswaee aur buraee chimat gaee

Woh jo apni janon per zulm kertay hain, farishtay jab unn ki jaan qabz kerney lagtay hain uss waqt woh jhuk jatay hain kay hum buraee nahi kertay thay. Kiyon nahi? Allah Taalaa khoob jannay wala hai jo kuch tum kertay thay
Pus abb to hameshgi kay tor per tum jahannum kay darwazon mein dakhil ho jao, pus kiya hi bura thikana hai ghuroor kerney walon ka

Aur perhez gaaron say poocha jata hai kay tumharay perwerdigar ney kiya nazil farmaya hai? To woh jawab detay hain kay achay say acha. Jin logon ney bhalaee ki unn kay liye uss duniya mein bhalaee hai, aur yaqeenan aakhirat ka ghar to boht hi behtar hai, aur kiya hi khoob perhez gaaron ka ghar hai

Hameshgi walay baghaat jahan woh jayen gay jin kay neechay nehren beh rahi hain, jo kuch yeh talab keren gay o haan unn kay liye mojood hoga. Perhez gaaron ko Allah Taalaa ussi tarah badlay ata farmata hai
Woh jin ki janen farishtay uss haal mein qabz kertay hain kay woh pak saaf hun kehtay hain kay tumharay liye salamti hi salamti hai, jao jannat mein apney unn aemaal kay badlay jo tum kertay thay.

Kiya yeh ussi baat ka intizar ker rahey hain kay unn kay pass farishtay aajayen ya teray rab ka hukum aajaye? Aisa hi unn logon ney bhi kiya tha jo unn say pehlay thay. Unn per Allah Taalaa ney koi zulm nahi kiya balkay)yeh woh khud apni janon per zulm kertay rahey
Pus unn kay buray aemaal kay natijay unhen mill gaye aur jiss ki hansi uratay thay uss ney unn ko gher liya

Mushrik logon ney kaha kay agar Allah Taalaa chahata to hum aur humaray baap daday uss kay siwa kissi aur ki ibadat hi na kertay, na uss kay farman kay baghair kissi cheez ko haram kertay. Yehi fail unn say pehlay kay logon ka raha. To rasoolon per to sirf khullam khulla paygham ka phoncha dena hai

Hum ney her ummat mein rasool bheja kay (logo!) sirf Allah ki ibadat kero aur uss kay siwa tamam maboodon say bacho. Pus baaz logon ko to Allah Taalaa ney hidayat di aur baaz per gumrahi sabit hogaee, pus tum khud zamin mein chal phir ker dekh lo kay jhutlanay walon ka anjam kaisa kuch hua?
Go aap unn ki hidayat kay khuwahish mand rahey hain lekin Allah Taalaa ussay hidayat nahi deta jissay gumrah ker dey aur na unn ka koi madadgar hota hai

Woh log bari sakht sakht qasmen kha kha ker kehtay hain kay mardon ko Allah Taalaa zindah nahi keray ga. Kiyon nahi zaroor zindah keray ga yeh to uss ka bar-haq lazmi wada hai, lekin aksar log jantay nahi
Uss liye bhi kay yeh log jiss cheez mein ikhtilaf kertay thay ussay Allah Taalaa saaf biyan ker dey aur uss liye bhi kay khud kafir apna jhoota hona jaan len
Hum jab kissi cheez ka iradah kertay hain to sirf humara yeh keh dena hota hai kay hoja, pus woh hojati hai

Jin logon ney zulm bardasht kerney kay baad Allah ki raah mein tarak watan kiya hai hum unhen behtar say behtar thikana duniya mein ata farmaeen gay aur aakhirat ka sawab to boht hi bara hai, kaash kay log uss say waqif hotay
Woh jinhon ney daman sabar na chora aur apney paalney walay hi per bharosa kertay rahey
Aap say pehlay bhi hum mardon ko hi bhejtay rahey, jin ki janib wahee utara kertay thay pus agar tum nahi jantay to ahl ilm say daryaft ker lo

Daleelon aur kitabon kay sath, yeh zikar (kitab) hum ney aap ki taraf utara hai kay logon ki janib jo nazil farmaya gaya hai aap ussay khol khol ker biyan ker den, shayad kay woh ghor ghor-o-fiker keren
Bad-tareen dao paich kerney walay kiya uss baat say bey khof hogaye hain kay Allah Taalaa unhen zamin mein dhansa dey ya unn kay pass aisi jagah say azab aajaye jahan ka unhen wahm o guman bhi na ho
Ya unhen chaltay phirtay pakar ley. Yeh kissi soorat mein Allah Taalaa ko aajiz nahi ker saktay
Ya unhen dara dhamka ker pakar ley, pus yaqeenan tumhara perwerdigar aala shafqat aur intehaee reham wala hai
Kiya unhon ney Allah ki makhlooq mein say kissi ko bhi nahi dekha? Kay uss kay saye dayen bayen jhuk jhuk ker Allah Taalaa kay samney sir sujood hotay aur aajzi ka izhar kertay hain
Yaqeenan aasman o zamin kay kul jaandaar aur tamam farishtay Allah Taalaa kay samney sajday kertay hain aur zara bhi takabbur nahi kertay
Aur apney rab say jo unn kay upper hai, kapkapatay rehtay hain aur jo hukum mill jaye uss ki tameel kertay hain
Allah Taalaa irshad farma chuka hai kay do mabood na banao. Mabood to sirf o hi akela hai, pus tum sab sirf mera hi darr khof rakho
Aasmano mein aur zamin mein jo kuch hai sab ussi ka hai aur ussi ki ibadat lazim hai, kiya phir tum uss kay siwa auron say dartay ho?
Tumharay pass jitni bhi nematen hain sab ussi ki di hui hain, abb bhi jab tumhen koi museebat paish aajaye to ussi ki taraf nala o faryad kertay ho
Aur jahan uss ney woh museebat tum say dafa ker di tum mein say kuch log apney rab kay sath shirk kerney lag jatay hain
Kay humari di hui nematon ki na-shukri keren. Acha kuch faeedah utha aakhir kaar tumhen maloom ho hi jaye ga
Aur jissay jantay boojhtay bhi nahi uss ka hissa humari di hui rozi mein say muqarrar kertay hain, o Allah tumharay uss bohtan ka sawal tum say zaroor hi kiya jaye ga
Aur woh Allah subhana o Taalaa kay liye larkiyan muqarrar kertay hain aur apney liye woh jo apni khuwahish kay mutabiq ho
Unn mein say jab kissi ko larki honey ki khabar di jaye to uss ka chehra siyah ho jata hai aur dil hi dil mein ghutney lagta hai
Uss buri khabar ki wajah say logon say chupa chupa phirta hai. Sochta hai kay kiya uss ko zillat kay sath liye huye hi rahey ya ussay mitti mein daba dey, aah! kiya hi buray faislay kertay hain?
Aakhirat per eman na rakhney walon ki hi buri misal hai, Allah kay liye to boht hi buland sift hai, woh bara hi ghalib aur ba-hikmat hai

Agar logon kay gunah per Allah Taalaa unn ki girift kerta to aur zamin per aik bhi jaandaar baqi na rehta, lekin woh to unhen aik waqt muqarrar tak dheel deta hai, jab unn ka woh waqt aajata hai to woh aik sa’at na peechay reh saktay hain aur na aagay barh saktay hain

Aur woh apney liye jo pasand rakhtay hain Allah kay liye sabit kertay hain aur unn ki zabanen jhooti baaten biyan kerti hain kay unn kay liye khoobi hai. Nahi nahi, dar-asal unn kay liye aag hai aur yeh dozakhiyon kay paish roo hain

O Allah! hum ney tujh say pehlay ki ummaton ki taraf bhi apney rasool bhejay lekin shetan ney unn kay aemaal bad unn ki nigahon mein aaraasta ker diye, woh shetan aaj bhi unn ka rafiq bana hua hai aur unn kay liye dard naak azab hai
Uss kitab ko hum ney aap per uss liye utara hai kay aap unn kay liye her uss cheez ko wazeh ker den jiss mein woh ikhtilaf ker rahey hain aur yeh eman walon kay liye rehnumaee aur rehmat hai
Aur Allah aasman say pani barsa ker uss say zamin ko uss ki maut kay baad zindah ker deta hai. Yaqeenan uss mein unn logon kay liye nishani hai jo sunen

Tumharay liye to chopayon mein bhi bari ibrat hai kay hum tumhen uss kay pet mein jo kuch hai ussi mein say gobar aur lahoo kay darmiyan say khalis doodh pilatay hain jo peenay walon kay liye sehta pachta hai
Aur khajoor aur angoor kay darakhton kay phalon say tum sharab bana letay ho aur umdah rozi bhi. Jo log aqal rakhtay hain unn kay liye to uss mein boht bari nishani hai
Aap kay rab ney shehad ki makhi kay dil mein yeh baat daal di kay paharon mein darakhton aur logon ki banaee hui unchi unchi tattiyon mein apney ghar (chattay) bana

Aur her tarah kay meway kha aur apney rab ki aasan raahon mein chalti phirti reh, unn kay pet say rang barang ka mashroob nikalta hai, jiss kay rang mukhtalif hain aur jiss mein logon kay liye shifa hai ghor-o-fikar kerney walon kay liye uss mein bhi boht bari nishani hai

Allah Taalaa ney hi tum sab ko peda kiya hai o hi phir tumhen fot keray ga, tum mein aisay bhi hain jo bad-tareen umar ki taraf lotaye jatay hain kay boht kuch jannay boojhney kay baad bhi na janen. Be-shak Allah dana aur tawana hai

Allah Taalaa hi ney tum mein say aik ko doosray per rozi mein ziyadti dey rakhi hai, pus jinhen ziyadti di gaee hai woh apni rozi apney ma-tehat ghulamon ko nahi detay kay woh aur yeh uss mein barabar ho jayen, to kiya yeh log Allah ki nematon kay munkir ho rahey hain?

Allah Taalaa ney tumharay liye tum mein say hi tumhari biwiyan peda kin aur tumhari biwiyon say tumharay liye tumharay betay aur potay peda kiye aur tumhen achi achi cheezen khaney ko den. Kiya phir bhi log baatil per eman layen gay? Aur Allah Taalaa ki nematon ki na-shukri keren gay?
Aur woh Allah Taalaa kay siwa unn ki ibadat kertay hain jo aasmano aur zamin say unhen kuch bhi to rozi nahi dey saktay aur na kuch qudrat rakhtay hain
Pus Allah Taalaa kay liye misalen mat banao Allah Taalaa khoob janta hai aur tum nahi jantay

Allah Taalaa aik misal biyan farmata hai kay aik ghulam hai doosray ki milkiyat ka, jo kissi baat ka ikhtiyar nahi rakhta aur aik aur shakhs hai jissay hum ney apney pass say maqool rozi dey rakhi hai, jiss mein say woh chupay khulay kharach kerta hai. Kiya yeh sab barabar hosaktay hain? Allah Taalaa hi kay liye sab tareef hai, balkay)yeh unn mein say aksar nahi jantay

Allah Taalaa aik aur misal biyan farmata hai, do shakhson ki, jin mein say aik to goonga hai aur kissi cheez per ikhtiyar nahi rakhta balkay)yeh woh apney malik per bojh hai kahen bhi ussay bhejay woh koi bhalaee nahi laata, kiya yeh aur woh jo adal ka hukum deta hai aur hai bhi seedhi raah per, barabar hosaktay hain?

Aasmano aur zamin ka ghaib sirf Allah Taalaa hi ko maloom hai. Aur qayamat ka amar to aisa hi hai jaisay aankh ka jhapakna, balkay)yeh uss say bhi ziyadah qareeb. Be-shak Allah Taalaa her cheez per qadir hai
Allah Taalaa ney tumhen tumhari maaon kay peton say nikala hai kay uss waqt tum kuch bhi nahi jantay thay, ussi ney tumharay kaan aur aankhen aur dil banaye kay tum shukar guzari kero

Kiya unn logon ney parindon ko nahi dekha jo tabey farman ho ker fiza mein hain, jinhen ba-juz Allah Taalaa kay koi aur thamay huye nahi, be-shak uss mein eman laney walay logon kay liye bari nishaniyan hain

Aur Allah Taalaa ney tumharay liye tumharay gharon mein sakoonat ki jagah bana di hai aur ussi ney tumharay liye chopayon ki khalon kay ghar bana diye hain, jinhen tum halka phulka patay ho apney kooch kay din aur apney therney kay din bhi, aur unn ki oon aur roo’on aur baalon say bhi uss ney boht say saman aur aik waqt muqarrara tak kay liye faeedah ki cheezen banayen

Allah hi ney tumharay liye apni peda kerdah cheezon mein say saye banaye hain aur ussi ney tumharay liye paharon mein ghaar banaye hain aur ussi ney tumharay liye kertay banaye hain jo tumhen garmi say bachayen aur aisay kertay bhi jo tumhen laraee kay waqt kaam aayen. Woh ussi tarah apni poori poori nematen dey raha hai kay tum hukum bardaar bann jao
Phir bhi agar yeh mun moray rahen to aap per sirf khol ker tableegh ker dena hi hai
Yeh Allah ki nematen jantay pehchantay huye bhi unn kay munkir ho rahey hain, balkay)yeh unn mein say aksar na-shukray hain
Aur jiss din hum her ummat mein say gawah khara keren gay phir kafiron ko na ijazat di jaye gi aur na unn say tauba kerney ko kaha jaye ga
Aur jab yeh zalim azab dekh len gay phir na to unn say halka kiya jaye ga aur na woh dheel diye jayen gay

Aur jab mushrikeen apney shareekon ko dekh len gay to kahen gay aey humaray perwerdigar! yehi humaray woh shareek hain jinhen hum tujhay chor ker pukara kertay thay, pus woh unhen jawab den gay kay tum bilkul hi jhootay ho
Uss din woh sab (aajiz hoker) Allah kay samney ita’at ka iqrar paish keren gay aur jo bohtan baazi kiya kertay thay woh sab unn say gumm ho jaye gi
Jinhon ney kufur kiya aur Allah ki raah say roka hum unhen azab per azab barhatay jayen gay, yeh badla hoga unn ki fitna pardaziyon ka

Aur jiss din hum her ummat mein unhi mein say unn kay muqablay per gawah khara keren gay aur tujhay unn sab per gawah bana ker layen gay aur hum ney tujh per yeh kitab nazil farmaee hai jiss mein her cheez ka shafi biyan hai, aur hidayat aur rehmat aur khushkhabri hai musalmanon kay liye

Allah Taalaa adal ka, bhalaee ka aur qarabat daron kay sath salook kerney ka hukum deta hai aur bey-hayai kay kaamon, shaista herkaton aur zulm o ziyadti say rokta hai, woh khud tumhen naseehaten ker raha hai kay tum naseehat hasil kero

Aur Allah kay ehad ko poora kero jab kay tum aapas mein qol o qarar kero aur qasmon ko unn ki pukhtagi kay baad mat toro, halankay tum Allah Taalaa ko apna zaamin thehra chukay ho, tum jo kuch kertay ho Allah uss ko bakhoobi jaan raha hai

Aur uss aurat ki tarah na ho jao jiss ney apna soot mazboot kaatney kay baad tukray tukray kerkay tor dala, kay tum apni qasmon ko aapas kay makar ka baees thehrao, uss liye kay aik giroh doosray giroh say barha charha hojaye. Baat sirf yehi hai kay uss ehad say Allah tumhen aazma raha hai. Yaqeenan Allah Taalaa tumharay liye qayamat kay din her uss cheez ko khol ker biyan ker dey ga jiss mein tum ikhtilaf ker rahey thay

Agar Allah chahata tum sab ko aik hi giroh bana deta lekin woh jissay chahaye gumrah kerta hai aur jissay chahaye hidayat deta hai, yaqeenan tum jo kuch ker rahey ho uss kay baray mein baaz purs ki janey wali hai

Aur tum apni qasmon ko aapas ki dagha-bazi ka bahana na banao. Phir to tumharay qadam apni mazbooti kay baad dagmaga jayen gay aur tumhen sakht saza bardasht kerna paray gi kyunkay tum ney Allah ki raah say rok diya aur tumhen bara sakht azab hoga
Tum Allah kay ehad ko thoray mol kay badlay na baich diya kero. Yaad rakho Allah kay pass ki cheez hi tumharay liye behtar hai ba-shart-e-kay tum mein ilm ho
Tumharay pass jo kuch hai sab faani hai aur Allah Taalaa kay pass jo kuch hai baqi hai. Aur sabar kerney walon ko hum bhalay aemaal ka behtareen badla zaroor ata farmaeen gay
Jo shakhs nek amal keray mard ho ya aurat, lekin ba-emaan ho to hum ussay yaqeenan nihayat behtar zindagi ata farmaeen gay. Aur unn kay nek aemaal ka behtar badla bhi unhen zaroor zaroor den gay
Quran parhney kay waqt randay huye shetan say Allah ki panah talab kero
Eman walon aur apney perwerdigar per bharosa rakhney walon per uss ka zor mutlaqan nahi chalta
Haan uss ka ghalba unn per to yaqeenan hai jo ussi say rafaqat keren aur ussay Allah ka shareek thehrayen

Aur jab hum kissi aayat ki jagah doosri aayat badal detay hain aur jo kuch Allah Taalaa nazil farmata hai ussay woh khoob janta hai to yeh kehtay hain kay to to bohtan baaz hai. Baat yeh hai kay unn mein say aksar jantay hi nahi
Keh dijiye kay ussay aap kay rab ki taraf say Jibraeel haq kay sath ley ker aaye hain takay eman walon ko Allah Taalaa istaqamat ata farmaye aur musalmanon ki rehnumaee aur bisharat ho jaye
Humen bakhoobi ilm hai kay yeh kafir kehtay hain kay ussay to aik aadmi sikhata hai uss ki zaban jiss ki taraf yeh nisbat ker rahey hain ajami hai aur yeh Quran to saaf arabi zaban mein hai.
Jo log Allah Taalaa ki aayaton per eman nahi rakhtay unhen Allah ki taraf say bhi rehnumaee nahi hoti aur unn kay liye alamnaak azab hain
Jhoot iftra to o hi bandhtay hain jinhen Allah Taalaa ki aayaton per eman nahi hota. Yehi log jhootay hain

Jo shakhs apney eman kay baad Allah say kufur keray ba-juz uss kay jiss per jabar kiya jaye aur uss ka dil eman per bar-qarar ho, magar jo log khulay dil say kufur keren to unn per Allah ka ghazab hai aur unhi kay liye boht bara azab hai
Yeh uss liye kay unhon ney duniya ki zindagi ko aakhirat say ziyadah mehboob rakha. Yaqeenan Allah Taalaa kafir logon ko raah raast nahi dikhata
Yeh woh log hain jin kay dilon per aur jin kay kanon per aur jin ki aankhon per Allah ney mehar laga di hai aur yehi log ghafil hain
Kuch shak nahi kay yehi log aakhirat mein sakht nuksan uthaney walay hain
Jin logon ney fitnon mein dalay janey kay baad hijrat ki phir jihad kiya aur sabar ka saboot diya be-shak tera perwerdigar unn baaton kay baad unhen bakhshney wala aur meharbaniyan kerney wala hai
Jiss din her shakhs apni zaat kay liye larta jhagarta aaye aur her shakhs ko uss kay kiye huye aemaal ka poora badla diya jaye ga aur logon per (mutlaqan) zulm na kiya jaye ga

Allah Taalaa uss basti ki misal biyan farmata hai jo pooray aman o itminan say thi uss ki rozi uss kay pass ba-faraghat her jagah say chali aarahi thi. Phir uss ney Allah Taalaa ki nematon ka kufur kiya to Allah Taalaa ney ussay bhook aur darr ka maza chakhaya jo badla tha unn kay kartooton ka
Unn kay pass unhi mein say rasool phoncha phir bhi unhon ney ussay jhutlaya pus unhen azab ney dabocha aur woh thay hi zalim
Jo kuch halal aur pakeezah rozi Allah ney tumhen dey rakhi hai ussay khao aur Allah ki nemat ka shukar kero agar tum ussi ki ibadat kertay ho

Tum per sirf murdaar aur khoon aur sooar ka gosht aur jiss cheez per Allah kay siwa doosray ka naam pukara jaye haram hain, phir agar koi shakhs bey bus ker diya jaye na woh khuwahish-mand ho aur na hadd say guzarney wala ho to yaqeenan Allah bakhshney wala reham kerney wala hai

Kissi cheez ko apni zaban say jhoot moot na keh diya kero kay yeh halal hai aur yeh haram hai kay Allah per jhoot bohtan bandh lo, samajh lo kay Allah Taalaa per bohtan baazi kerney walay kaamyabi say mehroom hi rehtay hain
Unhen boht mamooli faeedah milta hai aur unn kay liye hi dard-naak azab hai
Aur yahudiyon per jo kuch hum ney haram kiya tha ussay hum pehlay hi say aap ko suna chukay hain, hum ney unn per zulm nahi kiya balkay)yeh woh khud apni janon per zulm kertay rahey
Jo koi jahalat say buray amal kerley phir tauba kerley aur islaah bhi kerley to phir aap ka rab bula shak o shuba)yeh bari bakhsish kerney wala aur nihayat hi meharban hai
Be-shak Ibrahim paishwa aur Allah Taalaa kay farmanbardar aur yak tarfa mukhlis thay. Woh mushrikon mein say na thay
Allah Taalaa ki nematon kay shukar guzaar thay, Allah ney unhen apna bargazeedah ker liya tha aur unhen raah raast sujha di thi
Hum ney ussay duniya mein bhi behtri di thi aur be-shak woh aakhirat mein bhi kaaron mein hain
Phir hum ney aap ki janib wahee bheji kay aap millat Ibrahim hanif ki pairwee keren, jo mushrikon mein say na thay

Haftay kay din ki azmat to sirf unn logon kay zimmay hi zaroori ki gaee thi jinhon ney uss mein ikhtilaf kiya tha, baat yeh hai kay aap ka perwerdigar khud hi unn mein unn kay ikhtilaf ka faisla qayamat kay din keray ga

Apney rab ki raah ki taraf logon ko hikmat aur behtareen naseehat kay sath bulaiye aur unn say behtareen tareeqay say guftugoo kijiye, yaqeenan aap ka rab apni raah say behakney walon ko bhi bakhoobi janta hai aur woh raah yafta logon say bhi poora waqif hai
Aur agar badla lo bhi to bilkul itna hi jitna sadma tumhen phonchaya gaya ho aur agar sabar kerlo to be-shak sabiron kay liye yehi behtar hai
Aap sabar keren baghair tofiq elahi kay aap sabar ker hi nahi saktay aur unn kay haal per ranjeedah na hun aur jo makar-o-faraib yeh kertay rehtay hain unn say tang dil na hun
Yaqeen mano kay Allah Taalaa perhezgaron aur nek kaaron kay sath hai
